entry_contract.production_document: One current document path or artifact identity
entry_contract.status: drafted | sample-produced | sample-approved | full-rendered | qa-passed | delivered | user-ready | published
entry_contract.evidence: Dated artifact identities, source locks, independent asset review rounds/findings/fixes/verification, sample delivery, authorization basis, feedback and publication receipt
entry_contract.asset_reviews: Per-scene/asset deliverable ledger: stage, independent technical/editorial/visual reviewers, revision/hash, shared rounds 1-3 maximum; stop early when clean; never reset on revision or reviewer changes; no relabeling repairs to evade gates; escalate capped material visual/critical issues
entry_contract.visual_coverage: Every scene ID/time range and transition: keyframes, actual temporal inspection, encoded master/phone evidence, concrete art-direction findings/fixes and explicit gaps; no objective beauty score
entry_contract.blockers: Unmet gates; do not infer acceptance from delivery
